text:
maya: Hey team — I clicked the org invite but GitHub shows 'You need to sign in via SSO for redwood-inference' and the repo list is empty. I enabled 2FA yesterday so not sure what's blocked. Anyone know who to add me to for client infra access?

sam: Welcome Maya! That SSO message usually means you need to authorize SAML for the org after accepting the invite. Try visiting https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/sso and click 'Authorize'.

maya: I tried that page and it redirects me to the company SSO page but then errors with "access_denied: account_not_linked". Using my work email (maya@redwood.com).

priya: Hmm can you check if your GitHub account is already linked to our IdP? We usually provision via SCIM for most hires. If SCIM failed you might need a manual link. Ping me your GitHub username and I'll check the IdP console.

invite-bot: Action required: finish SAML SSO authorization to access organization resources. Docs: https://redwood.internal/security/sso-github (internal).

maya: Username is maya-gh. Thanks Priya. Also not seeing eng-infra or eng-runtime teams listed under Teams.

sam: Priya can add you to teams once the IdP link is fixed. In the meantime I can grant org-level read so you can at least clone public repos that are internal. Do you need write on any specific repo now?

maya: Need write on infra-ops and ci-config to push a small change.

priya: I checked SCIM — provisioning failed due to email alias mismatch. I submitted a fix, please accept the new invite I just sent. After you accept, go to https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/sso and authorize. I'll also add eng-infra and eng-platform to your membership and grant repo write on infra-ops + ci-config.

maya: Got a new invite and accepted. Authorizing SSO worked this time. I can see the org and teams now but still can't push — git push errors with 'permission denied (publickey)'.

sam: Sounds like SSH key not added. Add your public key in GitHub Settings -> SSH and GPG keys, or use a PAT. For quick test you can run `ssh -T git@github.com` to verify.

maya: SSH key added, `ssh -T` prints 'Hi maya-gh! You've successfully authenticated'. Push succeeded. Thanks everyone! :tada:

priya: All set — added eng-infra and eng-platform, write on the two repos. If you hit Actions/Secrets permission issues, @sam can elevate.

maya: Closing out. Appreciate the quick help :)
